findings.summary: Current AGENTS managed block is too minimal and does not define a progressive disclosure reading order for technical users or agents.
Current init creates directories and indexes but does not generate architecture-blueprint.md or version-evolution-blueprint.md as first-class technical entry docs.
Current init does not distinguish greenfield and takeover project initialization semantics.
Current init flow does not yet materialize a project-onboarding state file or lifecycle adoption level to express how deeply Beacon has taken over project development.
